human_trace_texts.text: Open AMC Theatres and reach the primary workflow from the home/landing experience.
Search AMC Theatres for a representative venue, service, or booking, refine the query if needed, and open a relevant result.
Search AMC Theatres for a representative venue, service, or booking, refine the query if needed, and open a relevant result.
Exercise the Party / Attendee Count workflow on AMC Theatres with representative data and verify the resulting UI state and persistence.
Browse AMC Theatres for a representative venue, service, or booking without relying on a direct deep link.
Apply multiple filters on AMC Theatres and verify the visible results/state update correctly.
Change sorting or comparison controls on AMC Theatres and verify ordering/comparison state is correct.
Open a representative Venue / Service Detail on AMC Theatres and inspect the key metadata, options, and available actions.
Use the Availability / Showtimes workflow on AMC Theatres to select/change a valid time-related option and verify availability updates.
Use AMC Theatres's Ticket / Service Tier controls to select a non-default option and verify dependent price/availability/state updates.
Use AMC Theatres's Seat / Resource Selection controls to select a non-default option and verify dependent price/availability/state updates.
Exercise the Add-ons / Packages workflow on AMC Theatres with representative data and verify the resulting UI state and persistence.
Save/follow a representative venue, service, or booking through AMC Theatres's Save / Favorite flow and verify it appears in the corresponding saved state.
Create a new AMC Theatres account through the registration flow and reach the post-sign-up state.
Complete the Email / Account Verification step on AMC Theatres, including required fields, consent, and validation feedback.
Sign in to AMC Theatres with an existing account and verify the authenticated session and landing state.
Sign out of AMC Theatres and verify protected state is no longer accessible without re-authentication.
Exercise AMC Theatres's Password Reset flow through request, validation, and completion/recovery state.
Open a representative Profile / Preferences on AMC Theatres and inspect the key metadata, options, and available actions.
Review and change the Privacy / Consent options on AMC Theatres, then verify the stored privacy/consent state.
Exercise the Security / Session Management controls on AMC Theatres and verify device/session/security state changes persist.
Configure or trigger Notifications on AMC Theatres and verify the preference/status is reflected in the UI.
Open a representative Customer / Attendee Details on AMC Theatres and inspect the key metadata, options, and available actions.
Exercise the Special Requests / Notes workflow on AMC Theatres with representative data and verify the resulting UI state and persistence.
Complete the preceding AMC Theatres workflow and verify the Promo / Voucher state contains the expected identifiers and summary.
Exercise the Payment Method step on AMC Theatres using test data and verify totals, validation, and transition to the next state.
Reach AMC Theatres's Booking Review step, verify the complete summary, edit one prior field, and return with the updated summary.
Complete the preceding AMC Theatres workflow and verify the Booking Confirmation state contains the expected identifiers and summary.
Open a representative Ticket / QR / Appointment Details on AMC Theatres and inspect the key metadata, options, and available actions.
Configure or trigger Reminders / Notifications on AMC Theatres and verify the preference/status is reflected in the UI.
Complete the Manage Booking workflow on AMC Theatres and verify the submitted object's resulting state and confirmation.
Use the Reschedule workflow on AMC Theatres to select/change a valid time-related option and verify availability updates.
Exercise AMC Theatres's post-action Cancel / Refund workflow and verify the resulting status, eligibility, and confirmation.
Exercise Transfer / Share Booking on AMC Theatres, change access for another user/recipient, and verify the resulting permissions or shared state.
Open AMC Theatres's Contact Venue / Provider path from a relevant workflow and verify contextual help/contact options are reachable.
Create or update a representative rating/review through AMC Theatres's Review / Rating workflow and verify public/private display state.
Use the No Availability / Waitlist workflow on AMC Theatres to select/change a valid time-related option and verify availability updates.
Trigger or simulate the Payment Failure / Retry condition on AMC Theatres and verify validation, retry/recovery behavior, and state preservation.
Trigger the No Results / Empty State condition on AMC Theatres and verify the user sees the correct recovery options without corrupting prior state.
Trigger or simulate the Invalid Input / Validation condition on AMC Theatres and verify validation, retry/recovery behavior, and state preservation.
Trigger or simulate the Loading / Retry condition on AMC Theatres and verify validation, retry/recovery behavior, and state preservation.
Open AMC Theatres's Help / Support path from a relevant workflow and verify contextual help/contact options are reachable.
Exercise the Movie / Theater Switch workflow on AMC Theatres with representative data and verify the resulting UI state and persistence.
Complete the Format Selection (IMAX / Dolby / 3D) step on AMC Theatres with representative data, including required-field and conditional validation.
Use the map/location view on AMC Theatres, change the visible area or selection, and verify list/map synchronization.
Modify an existing venue, service, or booking on AMC Theatres using Concessions Preorder and verify the updated state persists after navigation/reload.
Open the Loyalty / Membership workflow on AMC Theatres, select or modify an option, and verify pricing/status changes before finalization.

[862] On AMC Theatres, buy 2 IMAX tickets for the highest-rated movie currently showing at AMC Empire 25 in New York, select an upcoming Friday evening showtime, and choose two adjacent center seats in rows E–H
